question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is "**equal**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Blank 2 will imply how the principles determine the equality of citizens before the law.**
 
• **Among the given options, the most appropriate word to fill the blank is "equal."**
 
 
• "Equal" means having the same quantity, size, degree, value, or status.(बराबर)
 
 
• ​Example: Equal opportunities should be provided to both men and women.
 
 
 
 
 
• ​​It fits the context of the sentence appropriately.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "Irregular" means not following a predictable pattern or shape.(अनियमित)
 
• "Unequal" means not being the same in quantity, size, degree, value, or status.(असमान)
 
• "Unfair" means not just or equitable.(अनुचित)
